text.title: API Gateway Patterns & Technology Selection Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure to apply the api-gateway-patterns methodology end-to-end.

step.name: audit-clients
step.action: List every (client, service) edge and flag cross-cutting concerns each edge needs.
step.decision-gate: If matrix shows ≤2 edges with 0 cross-cutting concerns, recommend skip.

step.name: pick-pattern
step.action: Choose pattern: edge (one client family), bff (multiple client families with divergent needs), per-service (high-isolation requirement), none.

step.name: score-products
step.action: Score candidate products on: managed-UX, plugin ecosystem, footprint, license, team familiarity.
step.decision-gate: If only 1 candidate scored, expand the candidate set — single-option scoring is rationalization.

step.name: draft-adr
step.action: Fill templates/gateway-selection-adr.md; record alternatives + rollback path.

step.name: wire-ci-gate
step.action: Add a CI step that fails if any service exposes routes outside the chosen gateway pattern (route registry diff).
step.decision-gate: If team has no service catalog, ship a stub before merging the gate.

step.name: design-stateless-gateway
step.action: Configure the gateway stateless per r6 — JWT/mTLS for auth state, Redis for rate-limit counters, no business logic in plugins. Route any aggregation to a separate BFF (r13). If Kong, commit to DB or DB-less mode now (r12).
step.decision-gate: If any plugin needs backend state to decide, stop and create the BFF first.

step.name: wire-cross-cutting-concerns
step.input: Auth provider, X-Forwarded-For policy, timeout budget.
step.action: Configure per-consumer rate limiting (r7), X-Request-ID generation and propagation (r8), the upstream < gateway < client timeout cascade (r9), and per-upstream circuit breakers (r10).

step.name: add-smoke-tests
step.action: Pair every route change with a smoke test (curl script or Pact contract) proving route, auth and rate-limit behaviour; commit the tests beside the gateway config.

step.name: validate-and-deploy
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-api-gateway-patterns.py --file artefact.json`; deploy through the GitOps controller named in `gitops.managed_by` (r11); verify smoke tests green.
step.decision-gate: If the deploy path is a hand-run reload, block — r11 requires a controller.
